TC-14/S16.title: No placeholder token in any generated note: targeted fixtures plus every note from S11 to S19
TC-14/S16.detail: Dataset gen-notes-a on dev (live Haiku 4.5), through the app's UI: H-16 (discharge, a dictated address and phone), H-17 (H&P, 'put today's date on it'), N-16 (SNF admission, address and phone), N-17 (SNF follow-up, 'sign and date') — none carries {ADDRESS}, {PHONE}, {NAME}, [Today's date], [Physician name], [Physician, [Today, [Date, [Insert or [Patient name]: 4/4. Recorded (Q14): H-16 shows the guardrail's '[… withheld]' marker in place of the dictated address / phone. The same placeholder list was applied to every other note of this package: none of the 64 dev notes (S11–S19, S01, S02, both journeys runs) carries a placeholder token.
